summary.one_line: The new bilingual research pages and deleted-route replacements pass; only two disclosed draft-map limits remain.

purpose.evidence: Read the 36 cumulative Markdown paths and examined the 5001a3c..HEAD deletion delta. The 32 current RU/EN site pages form 16 pairs, including 11 new subject pairs, revised formats, and retained placement/about/contribution pages. The four empty seed topics in each language were removed; the new home and knowledge map point to concrete mechanisms and explicitly open questions. The site does not claim to be a complete engine specification or an official wiki.

structure.evidence: Compared paired frontmatter and page roles under CONTRIBUTING: landing pages route to live content; resource-overrides gives one executable how-to; formats, creatures, banks, build and placement internals are reference; test maps, native UI, public inputs and preview explain mechanisms. Current nav/theme/home links resolve to replacements. Eight deleted seed routes appear only in the negative-route Playwright test, and generated 33 HTML pages match 32 Markdown pages plus 404. The private preservation ledger inventories 27 sources/478 headings at topic level, not line-by-line republication.

specificity.evidence: Checked new claims against authorized research/mechanism notes: Universe archive counts 5159/1075/4047/37 and 1771/605/942/224; bank catalog 25 definitions/12 confirmed Types/13 AG_INFO families, demon-bank 15-slot tier bounds 90-135 through 180-225, and elemental variant 15 of each type =60; CombatSize loader clamps 1..2 (102 small/77 large among 179 definitions); Start/COMBAT_RESULTS timing and observed 0|1|13|10|0; native UI 197x110 ArmyWnd, 19 names/12 families and 24-byte mask cleanup; test-map Grass below StoneRoad and special movement refill. Placement internals preserve late corrections. These are cross-checks against research records, not independent game-binary or resource-archive remeasurement.

reproducibility.evidence: The menu-marker page supplies a standalone Python ZIP packer with exact member UI/MainMenu2/Version.txt, UTF-16LE BOM, source member date+2s, UserMODs install/rollback and observable marker. Parent reports running this fenced script offline in TemporaryDirectory against the pinned archive with member/BOM/marker checks; I compared the path/marker with the authorized mod.json and research smoke result. Combat callback and SHA commands are scoped to their contexts. The research-map/SDK polygon is explicitly not distributed; game steps in other pages are explanations rather than promised complete procedures. Full build/check (8 Node, 21 Python, 33 HTML), 12 browser tests, secret scan and 32 routes at five widths passed per parent.

evidence.evidence: Compared the new public pages with the named private research and mechanism summaries, prioritizing later corrections: bank guard grouping, OrcDeposit unresolved Type, gold conversion unverified, CombatSize not tier, same-type merge unreachable, world/local guard mismatch, fixed field depth, equal-key sort, preview physical RMB click versus unconfirmed hold, and no universal prediction accuracy. Viewed both archived gremlin screenshots: base card shows speed 3/health 5, upgraded card speed 5/health 6. I did not rerun Heroes, rehash private binaries, authenticate all XDB values independently, or certify every historical heading; the private ledger preserves originals and maps topics only.

applicability.evidence: New technical pages identify the investigated Universe build through the pinned hash page and distinguish XML/resource definitions, code emulation, prototype behavior and live checks. Examples state limits: bank table lists possible guards, not hidden actual variants; the menu marker proves one override, not archive-wide precedence; test maps separate ordinary neutral attacks from scripted StartCombat; native UI is not an SDK; preview cards use synthetic one-creature descriptors, not hidden quantities; placement code remains scoped to its traced pass. All current article statuses are draft, so this review does not promote them to verified. The final build-reference pair specifies inspected EXE ImageBase 0x400000 and labels function addresses absolute virtual addresses, preventing readers from treating them as file offsets.

translations.evidence: Read all new English articles and corresponding Russian pages and checked the substantive parallel facts: the 13-bank-family/12-Type caveat, four elemental definitions, 15-slot guard bounds, marker command/rollback, callback result string, terrain fix, UI lifecycle, public-input boundary, projection card limits, and placement corrections. All 16 RU/EN pairs have reciprocal translation metadata, matching status/type/faction per passing validator. Home/nav/knowledge map links were updated in both languages. I did not perform a professional translation audit. Round2 edits are parallel: both About dates now read 2026-09-24, and both build pages give the same ImageBase/absolute-VA clarification.

maintenance.evidence: Deleted seed pages were removed in both languages and replacement links were updated in nav, theme, home and related articles. Browser test explicitly asserts removed routes and search entries absent; full 32-route/five-width audit passed per parent. CONTRIBUTING now says empty introductory placeholders are removed or replaced, while draft status still requires later content verification. Private preservation accounting retains original research and distinguishes published topic summaries from internal material; it does not guarantee line-by-line completeness. Review covers all 36 current cumulative Markdown paths, with two disclosed placement-map draft advisories. Both About pages now show updated: 2026-09-24, matching the knowledge-map edit; the prior minor findings are resolved.

findings.detail: The exact WorkshopPolygon arenas are not public, so readers cannot reproduce the pictured formations from this article alone. The draft discloses this and provides a Start callback and prepared records for testing coordinates on another map; the broader algorithm is not independently runtime-certified by this review.
